add_reading.title: Add reading
add_reading.rule: Only a validated cuff or a 24-hour monitor counts as a blood pressure value. Wearable data is never used.

accept_referral.title: Accept referral
accept_referral.body: You accept this referral. The coordinator then books the appointment with the patient.

reject_referral.title: Reject referral
reject_referral.rule: A rejected referral goes to the coordinator queue with your reason. Say what should happen instead.

assign_owner.title: Reassign owner
assign_owner.rule: The new owner becomes accountable for the current step. The change is recorded in the audit timeline.

book_appointment.title: Book appointment
book_appointment.rule: Insurance cover is shown before booking. All cover lines are simulated.
book_appointment.none: There are no open appointment slots.

escalate.title: Escalate
escalate.rule: Escalating asks for attention from the next level. It does not change the state.

complete_urgent_review.title: Complete urgent review
complete_urgent_review.rule: Only a clinician can end the urgent flag. Record what you decided.

reopen.title: Reopen case
reopen.rule: The case returns to the state it held before closure, with a new due date counted from now.

action.suppressedBody: The patient has withdrawn permission for this channel, so nothing was sent and the case did not move. A task to contact the patient by another agreed route was created.

actions.title: What you can do
actions.intro: Actions available to you at this step.
actions.none: There is nothing for you to do on this case right now.
actions.referBlocked: Referral is blocked. The patient has withdrawn permission to share their information with the receiving provider. Ask the patient before referring.
actions.coordinatorCannotClose: Only a clinician can close a case, and only with evidence or a recorded decision. A coordinator can escalate a case to a clinician instead.

closure.title: Close case
closure.rule: Only a clinician can close a case. A case is never closed without an evidence type plus either an evidence reference or a decision note of at least {{min}} characters. No timer or rule ever closes a case.

closure.docHint: For example the name of a letter or a clinic note.
closure.noteHint: At least {{min}} characters if you give no reference. Written so far: {{count}}.

transparency.title: How {{app}} makes decisions
transparency.intro: This page shows the rules the system follows, the numbers it uses, and where artificial intelligence is and is not used. Nothing here needs a sign in.
transparency.placeholderTitle: Every threshold and service level is a placeholder
transparency.placeholderBody: The numbers below are placeholders pending clinician sign-off. None of them is clinically validated. They live in one config file and each has a stated basis.
transparency.rule1: Routing, urgency, ownership, due dates and closure come from fixed rules. They work the same way with the wording tool switched off.
transparency.rule2Title: Only a clinician closes a case.
transparency.rule2: Closing needs an evidence type plus an evidence reference or a decision note of at least {{min}} characters. No timer or rule ever closes a case.
transparency.rule3Title: Blood pressure values come only from a validated cuff or a 24-hour monitor.
transparency.rule3: Wearable data is shown as a diary of activity and sleep and is never used as a blood pressure value.
transparency.rule4: The dashboard never shows an individual and hides any group with fewer than 5 people. No individual data goes to employers or insurers.
transparency.closureBody: Only a clinician can close a case, and never without evidence or a recorded decision. Each closure stores who closed it, when, the evidence type, and either an evidence reference or a decision note of at least {{min}} characters. A clinician can reopen a closed case with a reason.
transparency.evidenceTypes: Evidence types a clinician can choose from:
transparency.ai1: Messages use approved templates in English, Arabic and French by default. The template text is fixed and reviewed.
transparency.ai2: Staff can ask for optional re-wording of a template by a language model. It is off unless the server is set up for it.
transparency.ai3: A checker must pass any re-wording. Every number, date, time, name and phone value must be unchanged, no new numbers may appear, no diagnosis words are allowed, and the length and language must fit. If it fails, the template text is used.
transparency.ai4: A staff member must read and approve a re-worded message before it is sent. The approver is recorded.
transparency.ai5: A language model is never used for routing, urgency, ownership, due dates or closure. It only suggests wording.

sectionHints.thresholds: A raised reading is the start of a check, not a diagnosis. A severe reading goes to same-day clinician review.

sectionHints.unreachable_protocol: Reminders, a second channel and a call task. After that a clinician decides. The case is never closed automatically.
sectionHints.closure: Limits used by the closure rule.
sectionHints.lifestyle_plan: A missed week makes the next action smaller. Nothing is reset and there are no streaks.

transparency.templatesIntro: {{count}} approved templates. Each has fixed text in English, Arabic and French. SMS versions are shorter.
transparency.data1: Every person, reading, provider and message is fictional and generated by seeded code. There is no real patient data.
transparency.data2: Names such as IFHAS, Thiqa and Malaffi appear only as labels of simulated sources, and each such screen carries a Simulated tag.
transparency.data3: SMS and WhatsApp threads are simulated in a phone-style view. No message leaves this system.
transparency.data4: The dashboard simulation runs on synthetic people. It shows what the system measures and is not evidence of clinical effectiveness.
transparency.regionsBody: Each region has a time zone. Dates in messages and the days used for home readings follow the patient's region and the message language.
transparency.demoOn: Demo mode is on: guest sign in, the demo clock, reset and the simulated intake feed are available.
transparency.demoOff: Demo mode is off: guest sign in, the demo clock, reset and the simulated intake feed are switched off.
